fields.name: TvpExpressionHelpers table-valued record assignment compiler
fields.contract: TvpExpressionHelpers compiles table-valued-record write plans. For each previously unseen normalized column name, a plan contains compatible column metadata and one assignment that is performed only when that column is selected. The family varies by source value: strings (including enums as names) preserve a declared length; integer-like values and enums use the destination base type; DateOnly values become midnight DateTime values; GUID, floating-point, and binary values use their corresponding setters. Null reference values and nullable values without a value become database nulls; Guid.Empty, NaN, and an empty non-array binary value also become database nulls. A duplicate normalized name adds no second metadata entry or assignment.
